cases.name: terminal_query_not_run_on_preimage
cases.evidence: The terminal query referenced the table created by the migration and the application succeeded from a preimage where that table did not exist.

cases.name: prior_query_not_run_on_existing_ledger
cases.evidence: The prior query referenced an absent table while the matching ledger row and terminal state existed; only the terminal branch was sent.

cases.name: reconciliation_skips_missing_terminal_table
cases.evidence: A no-ledger reconciliation returned the prior state with terminal=null although the terminal query referenced an absent relation.

cases.name: select_insert_cannot_reach_exclusive_lock
cases.evidence: A role with schema usage plus SELECT and INSERT on the ledger failed at the bounded admission guard; no source table or ledger row was created.

cases.name: ambiguous_ack_no_resend_fail_closed
cases.evidence: The first transaction committed and then raised a synthetic transport error. The caller made one state-specific read-only reconciliation, did not resend the INSERT/source SQL, and did not convert the preexisting-looking final state into success.

cases.name: exit0_invalid_stdout_reconciles
cases.evidence: A successful psql exit with missing stdout remained distinguishable from an ambiguous transport failure and was confirmed by one read-only reconciliation.

limits: This is isolated local PostgreSQL 17.11 evidence, not hosted Supabase or an operating database readback.
Historical PG15.8 and PG17.6 results are not promoted to these source hashes.
The separate bundle PG17.6 fixture owned by the root task is not used as evidence for these files.
